comment: Index order is not panel order: the enum runs STEP_SWITCH, BI_SWITCH, STEPSIZE_SWITCH, KNOB_PARAM, SCALE_PARAM in threes, while the widget draws knob, scale, step switch, step-size switch and negative switch in a different arrangement (src/MentalKnobs.cpp:212-225); the tags are written from the widget. The step-size switch quantises to a twelfth of a volt by rounding to the nearest octave and then to the nearest semitone within it (src/MentalKnobs.cpp:137-144). The three displays are TransparentWidgets added with addChild and have no ParamWidget, so they are not in the census position lists. The module has no inputs and the panel prints only its name.
